sourcePrompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit Image 1, the wide 3:2 fictional restaurant facade photograph, for the new Super Sauce identity. Preserve its symmetrical storefront structure, framing, proportions, glass doors, plants, golden-hour sky, interior warmth, and level eye-line. Change all visible fire-red exterior materials to the rich burgundy of Image 2. Replace all older lettering on the front sign with the EXACT logo from Image 2, as dimensional warm white channel letters with a small gold star above the U. The logo has one giant S spanning both rows and must use the supplied logo's unusual joined letter shapes and exact placement. Fit it centrally within the available sign with surrounding burgundy. Replace the red/white checkerboard lower fascia panels with solid cream stone panels set into deep burgundy frames. The final image remains a tasteful architectural concept photograph, front facing, wide 3:2, free of extra text and people.
